Tired of watching AI tutorials and still not building anything? 👀

Meet AI Builder's Camp (ABC), a program under AI Empowered Club.

In 8 weeks, you'll:
✅ Discover your purpose
✅ Build your own digital product
✅ Learn how to sell it

…with Coach Jazmine, Coach Lloyd, your AI Council Leaders and a community that won't let you quit.

You are the hero. AI is the tool. 💜

Curious if ABC fits you? Send us a message.
